mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM fund_financing_pledge_info_lib p INNER JOIN (SELECT main_id AS financing_id, MAX(version) AS version FROM common_version t1 WHERE t1.module = 'FUND_FINANCING' AND version_type = 1 GROUP BY main_id) m ON p.financing_id = m.financing_id AND p.version = m.version WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}
